source.design: combinational pdpu_top. N overridden from 4 to 16; posit(8,2) inputs -> posit(16,2) accumulator and result, ALIGN_WIDTH=14, CARRY_W=5, SUM_W=19. Identical architecture, formats and rounding to the N=4 reference, so lane count is the only change.
source.port: upstream SystemVerilog -> Spire: bit-exact functional port. Reductions mirror the reference (balanced comparator tree for the exponent maximum, carry-save tree for the accumulate)
source.oracle: vectors.dat expected_result is the reference RTL's own output (_debug/gen_vectors.py); the unit is architecturally inexact vs ideal posit math, so reference-as-oracle is the only correct golden
source.testbench: 2,000,000 directed + randomized vectors; vectors.dat shared with pdpu_dot16
